name: Aston Martin DB12
description: The Aston Martin DB12 is the successor to the acclaimed DB11, unveiled in 2023 as the world's first super tourer. Powered by a 4.0-liter twin-turbocharged V8 engine developed in partnership with Mercedes-AMG, the DB12 produces 671 hp and 800 Nm of torque, representing a 34% increase in power over its predecessor. The engine is mated to an 8-speed ZF automatic transmission driving the rear wheels, enabling a 0-100 km/h sprint in 3.6 seconds and a top speed of 325 km/h. The DB12 features an all-new chassis with significantly improved rigidity, electronic limited-slip differential, and adaptive damping for exceptional handling dynamics. Its elegant design continues Aston Martin's grand touring tradition while delivering genuine supercar performance, bridging the gap between luxury GT and sports car.
